examples.text_en: These games are very addictive for young players.
examples.text_zh: 这些游戏对年轻玩家来说很容易让人上瘾。

examples.text_en: Many people find this simple game quite addictive.
examples.text_zh: 许多人觉得这个简单的游戏相当令人上瘾。

examples.text_en: This additive gives the food a different look.
examples.text_zh: 这种添加剂让食物有了不同的外观。

examples.text_en: The new additive is safe for most people.
examples.text_zh: 这种新的添加剂对大多数人来说是安全的。

examples.text_en: Too much sound can addle the mind.
examples.text_zh: 太大的声音会让头脑昏乱。

examples.text_en: The bad news seemed to addle his thinking.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息似乎把他的思绪弄乱了。

examples.text_en: She tried to adduce evidence for her case.
examples.text_zh: 她试图为自己的说法举出证据。

examples.text_en: The report will adduce several facts to support this.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告将举出几个事实来支持这一点。

examples.text_en: Strict adherence to the rules is expected here.
examples.text_zh: 这里要求严格遵守规则。

examples.text_en: Her adherence to the plan never changed.
examples.text_zh: 她对计划的坚持从未改变。

examples.text_en: He became a loyal adherent of that faith.
examples.text_zh: 他成了那个信仰忠实的追随者。

examples.text_en: Every adherent of the movement attended the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 这场运动的每位追随者都参加了会议。

examples.text_en: This adhesive is strong enough for the job.
examples.text_zh: 这种粘合剂足够牢固，可以用来做这项工作。

examples.text_en: The paper will not stay without adhesive.
examples.text_zh: 没有粘合剂，这张纸就粘不住。

examples.text_en: They live in the adjoining house near the park.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在公园附近那座相邻的房子里。

examples.text_en: The two adjoining rooms share a single wall.
examples.text_zh: 这两个相邻的房间共用一堵墙。

examples.text_en: The group plans to adjourn the meeting until morning.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体打算把会议休会到早上。

examples.text_en: They will adjourn the meeting and meet again later.
examples.text_zh: 他们将暂时休会，稍后再继续开会。

examples.text_en: The court will adjudicate this case next week.
examples.text_zh: 法院将在下周裁定这起案件。

examples.text_en: Only the court can adjudicate such a difficult case.
examples.text_zh: 只有法院才能裁定这样一桩难办的案件。

examples.text_en: This small room is an adjunct to the house.
examples.text_zh: 这个小房间是这栋房子的附属部分。

examples.text_en: The book is a good adjunct to the course.
examples.text_zh: 这本书是这门课程的有益辅助。

examples.text_en: The bed is adjustable for people of any size.
examples.text_zh: 这张床可以调节，适合各种身材的人。

examples.text_en: This adjustable light makes the room feel different.
examples.text_zh: 这盏可调节的灯让房间给人的感觉不一样。

examples.text_en: The adjustment took only a few minutes.
examples.text_zh: 这次调整只花了几分钟。

examples.text_en: We made a small adjustment to the plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们对计划做了一点小调整。

examples.text_en: He had to adlib when he lost his note.
examples.text_zh: 他丢了讲稿时只好即兴发言。

examples.text_en: They often adlib when the play goes wrong.
examples.text_zh: 当戏演得不顺时，他们常常即兴发挥。

examples.text_en: They administrate the school with great care.
examples.text_zh: 他们非常用心地管理这所学校。

examples.text_en: She will administrate the program for two years.
examples.text_zh: 她将负责管理这个项目两年。

examples.text_en: The administration of the school takes much time.
examples.text_zh: 学校的管理需要花很多时间。

examples.text_en: The new administration changed several national policies.
examples.text_zh: 新一届政府机关改变了几项国家政策。

examples.text_en: The administrator of this program works very hard.
examples.text_zh: 这个项目的管理人工作非常努力。

examples.text_en: Each administrator must answer to the local government.
examples.text_zh: 每位行政官都必须向地方政府负责。

examples.text_en: Her wish to help the poor was very admirable.
examples.text_zh: 她想帮助穷人的愿望非常令人钦佩。

examples.text_en: He showed admirable care in all his daily work.
examples.text_zh: 他在日常工作中表现出令人钦佩的认真。

examples.text_en: They built their house from adobe and wood.
examples.text_zh: 他们用土坯和木头盖了房子。

examples.text_en: The adobe walls kept the room cool.
examples.text_zh: 土坯墙让房间保持凉爽。

examples.text_en: Many young people feel lost during adolescence.
examples.text_zh: 许多年轻人在青春期会感到迷茫。

examples.text_en: His adolescence was a time of great change.
examples.text_zh: 他的青春期是一段变化很大的时期。

examples.text_en: The adolescent boy often feels alone at night.
examples.text_zh: 这个青春期的男孩夜里常常感到孤独。

examples.text_en: Adolescent children need support from their parents.
examples.text_zh: 青春期的孩子需要父母的支持。

examples.text_en: The adoption of this new plan took several months.
examples.text_zh: 这项新计划的采用花了几个月时间。

examples.text_en: Their adoption of the child gave the family hope.
examples.text_zh: 他们收养这个孩子给全家带来了希望。

examples.text_en: The simple adornment made the room look beautiful.
examples.text_zh: 这件简单的装饰品让房间看起来很美。

examples.text_en: She had a gold adornment in her hair.
examples.text_zh: 她的头发上戴着一件金色的装饰品。

examples.text_en: She is quite adroit at solving hard problems.
examples.text_zh: 她相当善于解决难题。

examples.text_en: His adroit handling of the case impressed everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个案子的灵巧处理让所有人印象深刻。

examples.text_en: Some people adulate those with money and power.
examples.text_zh: 有些人谄媚那些有钱有势的人。

examples.text_en: He would adulate his chief to get a better job.
examples.text_zh: 为了得到更好的工作，他会谄媚上司。

examples.text_en: The adulteration of the food was a serious problem.
examples.text_zh: 食品掺假是一个严重的问题。

examples.text_en: Tests showed the adulteration of these daily products.
examples.text_zh: 检测显示这些日常产品存在掺杂。

examples.text_en: The first signs adumbrate a change in the plan.
examples.text_zh: 最初的迹象预示着计划的改变。

examples.text_en: His words adumbrate the plan he will present later.
examples.text_zh: 他的话预示了他稍后将提出的计划。

examples.text_en: Her hard work brought a great advancement at work.
examples.text_zh: 她的努力使她在工作中获得了很大的提升。

examples.text_en: The advancement of science has changed our daily life.
examples.text_zh: 科学的进步改变了我们的日常生活。

examples.text_en: The advent of the new year brought great hope.
examples.text_zh: 新年的来临带来了巨大的希望。

examples.text_en: Before the advent of the internet, life was very different.
examples.text_zh: 在互联网来临之前，生活截然不同。

examples.text_en: The meeting was an adventitious event for everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这次会面对大家来说是一次偶然的事件。

examples.text_en: It was an adventitious find, not the result of research.
examples.text_zh: 那是一次偶然的发现，并非研究的结果。

examples.text_en: My adventurous sister loves to travel alone.
examples.text_zh: 我爱冒险的姐姐喜欢独自旅行。

examples.text_en: They planned an adventurous trip through the mountains.
examples.text_zh: 他们计划了一次穿越群山的冒险之旅。

examples.text_en: The adverse news made him feel very bad.
examples.text_zh: 这个不利的消息让他感觉非常糟糕。

examples.text_en: They met with adverse results at every step.
examples.text_zh: 他们每走一步都遇到了不利的结果。

examples.text_en: The storm adversely affected the local crops.
examples.text_zh: 这场暴风雨对当地农作物造成了不利影响。

examples.text_en: Such changes could adversely affect our small business.
examples.text_zh: 这类变化可能对我们的生意产生不利影响。

examples.text_en: He did not advert to the problem in his report.
examples.text_zh: 他在报告中没有提及这个问题。

examples.text_en: The report will advert to this fact again later.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告稍后会再次提到这个事实。

examples.text_en: It is advisable to save money for hard times.
examples.text_zh: 为困难时期存钱是明智的。

examples.text_en: Early action is always advisable in such cases.
examples.text_zh: 在这种情况下，尽早行动总是明智的。

examples.text_en: She works as an adviser to the team.
examples.text_zh: 她担任这个团队的顾问。

examples.text_en: Our adviser suggested a different plan for us.
examples.text_zh: 我们的顾问为我们建议了另一个方案。

examples.text_en: His advocacy for the poor changed many lives.
examples.text_zh: 他为穷人发声的拥护改变了许多人的生活。

examples.text_en: The group is known for its advocacy of free thought.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体以其对自由思想的拥护而闻名。

examples.text_en: The project started under the aegis of the school.
examples.text_zh: 这个项目在学校的庇护下启动。

examples.text_en: They met under the aegis of a local group.
examples.text_zh: 他们在当地一个团体的支持下会面。

examples.text_en: You should aerate the water before you use it.
examples.text_zh: 使用之前，你应该让水接触空气。

examples.text_en: They aerate the ground to keep the food good.
examples.text_zh: 他们给土地通气，让作物长得好。

examples.text_en: The aerial view of the city was very beautiful.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市的空中景色非常美丽。

examples.text_en: They put a new aerial on the house last week.
examples.text_zh: 上周他们在房子上装了一根新天线。

examples.text_en: The study of aerodynamics helps us build better cars.
examples.text_zh: 对空气动力学的研究帮助我们造出更好的汽车。

examples.text_en: Aerodynamics is important for the design of any car.
examples.text_zh: 空气动力学对任何汽车的设计都很重要。

examples.text_en: She wants to study aeronautics at a top school.
examples.text_zh: 她想在一所顶尖学校学习航空学。

examples.text_en: The school shows the history of aeronautics.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校展示了航空学的历史。

examples.text_en: The aesthete spent hours in the art museum.
examples.text_zh: 这位审美家在艺术博物馆里待了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: As an aesthete, he cares deeply about beauty.
examples.text_zh: 作为唯美主义者，他非常在意美。

examples.text_en: The building has great aesthetic value for the city.
examples.text_zh: 这座建筑对这座城市有很大的美学价值。

examples.text_en: She made the choice for aesthetic value alone.
examples.text_zh: 她纯粹出于审美价值做了这个选择。

examples.text_en: The film has an aesthetical quality that we all love.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影有一种我们都喜爱的美学品质。

examples.text_en: They talked about the aesthetical value of the work.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了这件作品的美学价值。

examples.text_en: Our new chief is affable and easy to talk to.
examples.text_zh: 我们的新上司和蔼可亲，很容易交谈。

examples.text_en: The affable man made everyone feel at home.
examples.text_zh: 这位和蔼可亲的人让每个人都感到自在。

examples.text_en: Her little affectation was easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 她那点做作很容易被看出来。

examples.text_en: He talked with an affectation that no one liked.
examples.text_zh: 他说话带着一种谁也不喜欢的做作。

examples.text_en: The group gave the child strong affective support.
examples.text_zh: 这个群体给了孩子强有力的情感支持。

examples.text_en: Music can have a deep affective power for people.
examples.text_zh: 音乐能对人们产生深刻的情感力量。

examples.text_en: She signed the affidavit in front of the court.
examples.text_zh: 她在法庭面前签署了宣誓书。

examples.text_en: The affidavit must be written and signed today.
examples.text_zh: 宣誓书必须在今天写好并签署。

examples.text_en: His affiliation with the group started last year.
examples.text_zh: 他与这个团体的关系始于去年。

examples.text_en: The school has no affiliation with any political party.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校与任何政党都没有关系。

examples.text_en: She felt a natural affinity with those birds.
examples.text_zh: 她对那些鸟有一种天然的亲近感。

examples.text_en: He has a strong affinity for classical music.
examples.text_zh: 他对古典音乐有强烈的喜爱。

examples.text_en: The judge affirmed the earlier decision.
examples.text_zh: 法官确认了先前的裁决。

examples.text_en: They affirm their support for the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们确认了对新计划的支持。

examples.text_en: Please affix your name at the end of the page.
examples.text_zh: 请在页面末尾署上你的名字。

examples.text_en: They will affix a small note to the box.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把一张小便条贴在盒子上。

examples.text_en: Heavy rains afflict the region every spring.
examples.text_zh: 每年春天大雨都折磨着这个地区。

examples.text_en: Such worries afflict many young people today.
examples.text_zh: 这类忧虑困扰着如今许多年轻人。

examples.text_en: His long pain was a great affliction for him.
examples.text_zh: 长期的疼痛对他是一种沉重的折磨。

examples.text_en: The poor family faced one affliction after another.
examples.text_zh: 这个贫穷的家庭遭受着一个又一个的苦难。

examples.text_en: They lived in affluence after the business became great.
examples.text_zh: 生意壮大之后，他们过上了富裕的生活。

examples.text_en: The affluence of the city was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市的富裕对所有人来说都很明显。

examples.text_en: She took his remark as a personal affront.
examples.text_zh: 她把他那番话当成了人身侮辱。

examples.text_en: The insult was an affront to the entire team.
examples.text_zh: 这句侮辱是对整个团队的公开轻蔑。

examples.text_en: The town rebuilt slowly in the aftermath of the flood.
examples.text_zh: 洪水过后，小镇缓慢重建。

examples.text_en: Many families suffered in the aftermath of the war.
examples.text_zh: 战争过后，许多家庭受苦。

examples.text_en: They stood agape at the news from the city.
examples.text_zh: 听到来自那座城市的消息，他们目瞪口呆地站着。

examples.text_en: He was agape when he saw the final result.
examples.text_zh: 当他看到最终结果时，他张口发呆。

examples.text_en: A huge agglomerate of land was found near here.
examples.text_zh: 在这里附近发现了一大块陆地。

examples.text_en: They broke the agglomerate into small pieces.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这个大团打成了小块。

examples.text_en: He tried to aggrandize his part in the project.
examples.text_zh: 他试图夸大自己在这个项目中的作用。

examples.text_en: The book seems to aggrandize the power of the king.
examples.text_zh: 这本书似乎在夸大国王的权力。

examples.text_en: Scratching the skin can aggravate the rash.
examples.text_zh: 抓挠皮肤会使皮疹加重。

examples.text_en: Loud noise may aggravate his headache.
examples.text_zh: 大声的噪音可能会加重他的头痛。

examples.text_en: The constant noise was truly aggravating.
examples.text_zh: 持续不断的噪音实在令人恼火。

examples.text_en: He found the delays quite aggravating.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得这些延误相当恼人。

examples.text_en: The aggregate of these numbers is quite large.
examples.text_zh: 这些数字的总计相当大。

examples.text_en: We looked at the aggregate results of the test.
examples.text_zh: 我们看了这次测试的总计结果。

examples.text_en: The aggregation of the data took many hours.
examples.text_zh: 数据的汇集花了很多小时。

examples.text_en: They studied the aggregation of small groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了小群体的聚合。

examples.text_en: His aggressiveness at work surprised his coworkers.
examples.text_zh: 他在工作中的敢作敢为让同事们吃惊。

examples.text_en: Many coaches praised her energy and aggressiveness.
examples.text_zh: 许多教练都称赞她的活力和进取心。

examples.text_en: The new rules aggrieved the poor people most.
examples.text_zh: 新规定最让穷人感到委屈。

examples.text_en: He felt aggrieved by their hard words.
examples.text_zh: 他们刻薄的话语让他感到委屈。

examples.text_en: We were aghast at the sudden news.
examples.text_zh: 听到这突如其来的消息，我们惊呆了。

examples.text_en: She stood aghast when she saw the damage.
examples.text_zh: 看到损坏时，她吓得呆立当场。

examples.text_en: The agile cat climbed the tall tree.
examples.text_zh: 这只敏捷的猫爬上了那棵高树。

examples.text_en: These dancers are remarkably agile and strong.
examples.text_zh: 这些舞者格外灵活且强壮。

examples.text_en: The player showed great agility on the field.
examples.text_zh: 这名球员在场上表现出极大的灵活性。

examples.text_en: His agility helped him win the difficult game.
examples.text_zh: 他的敏捷帮助他赢得了这场艰难的比赛。

examples.text_en: The strong force can agitate the sea.
examples.text_zh: 强大的力量能搅动大海。

examples.text_en: Please do not agitate the water in the cup.
examples.text_zh: 请不要搅动杯子里的水。

examples.text_en: Her agitation was clear to everyone in the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里的每个人都清楚地看出她的焦虑。

examples.text_en: The news caused great agitation among the people.
examples.text_zh: 这个消息在人群中引起了极大的不安。

examples.text_en: He started to agonize over the difficult choice.
examples.text_zh: 他开始为这个艰难的选择而痛苦。

examples.text_en: Do not agonize about things you cannot change.
examples.text_zh: 不要为你无法改变的事情而苦恼。

examples.text_en: The long pain left him in great agony.
examples.text_zh: 长期的疼痛让他陷入极大的痛苦。

examples.text_en: She was in agony until the help came.
examples.text_zh: 在援手到来之前，她一直处在极大的痛苦中。

examples.text_en: The country has a long agrarian history.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家有着悠久的农耕历史。

examples.text_en: They studied the agrarian problems of the south.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了南部的土地问题。

examples.text_en: He wants to study agronomy at the university.
examples.text_zh: 他想在大学里学习农学。

examples.text_en: Agronomy helps people make better food.
examples.text_zh: 农学帮助人们种出更好的粮食。

examples.text_en: What ails the young man this morning?
examples.text_zh: 今天早上这个年轻人为什么烦恼？

examples.text_en: Money problems ail many families in this area.
examples.text_zh: 在这个地区，经济问题困扰着许多家庭。

examples.text_en: The doctor treated his minor ailment quickly.
examples.text_zh: 医生很快治好了他的小毛病。

examples.text_en: Stress can cause many common ailments.
examples.text_zh: 压力会引发许多常见的疾病。

examples.text_en: It was soon airborne after a long wait.
examples.text_zh: 长时间等待后，它很快就升空了。

examples.text_en: The ball stayed airborne for a short time.
examples.text_zh: 球在空中停留了很短的时间。

examples.text_en: The plane entered foreign airspace at noon.
examples.text_zh: 飞机在中午进入了外国空域。

examples.text_en: They closed the airspace above the busy city.
examples.text_zh: 他们关闭了这座繁忙城市上空的空域。

examples.text_en: The door was ajar, so we could hear them.
examples.text_zh: 门半开着，所以我们可以听见他们说话。

examples.text_en: She left the back door ajar all night.
examples.text_zh: 她整夜让后门半开着。

examples.text_en: Their two minds are very akin to each other.
examples.text_zh: 他们的两种想法彼此非常相近。

examples.text_en: This feeling is akin to a deep kind of love.
examples.text_zh: 这种感觉近似于一种深沉的爱。

examples.text_en: The statue was carved from pure alabaster.
examples.text_zh: 这座雕像是用纯净的雪花石膏雕成的。

examples.text_en: Her smooth skin looked like white alabaster.
examples.text_zh: 她光滑的肌肤看起来像洁白的雪花石膏。

examples.text_en: She said yes with great alacrity.
examples.text_zh: 她非常爽快地答应了。

examples.text_en: He moved with alacrity when the call came.
examples.text_zh: 电话来时，他敏捷地行动起来。

examples.text_en: Alas, the young man never came back home.
examples.text_zh: 唉，那个年轻人再也没有回家。

examples.text_en: Alas, their hope did not last very long.
examples.text_zh: 唉，他们的希望没有持续多久。

examples.text_en: He wanted to go, albeit not that day.
examples.text_zh: 他想去，尽管不是那天。

examples.text_en: The team won, albeit by a single point.
examples.text_zh: 这个队赢了，尽管只多一分。

examples.text_en: The albino rabbit stood out in the field.
examples.text_zh: 那只白化兔子在田野里格外显眼。

examples.text_en: We saw a rare albino deer near the river.
examples.text_zh: 我们在河边看到一只罕见的白化鹿。

examples.text_en: In the past, alchemy was a common study.
examples.text_zh: 在过去，炼金术是一门常见的研究。

examples.text_en: The book is about alchemy and its history.
examples.text_zh: 这本书讲的是炼金术及其历史。

examples.text_en: She read her book in the small alcove.
examples.text_zh: 她在那个小凹室里读书。

examples.text_en: The small alcove near the door was never used.
examples.text_zh: 门边那个小壁龛从未被使用过。

examples.text_en: The alder trees grow along the river.
examples.text_zh: 桤木沿着河边生长。

examples.text_en: He carved a small bowl from alder wood.
examples.text_zh: 他用桤木木料刻了一只小碗。

examples.text_en: Green algae is on the top of the water.
examples.text_zh: 绿色的藻类浮在水面上。

examples.text_en: The algae in the water changed its look.
examples.text_zh: 水中的藻类改变了它的样子。

examples.text_en: He used a short alias for his books.
examples.text_zh: 他为自己的书用了一个简短的化名。

examples.text_en: Under that alias, he lived a simple life.
examples.text_zh: 用那个化名，他过着简朴的生活。

examples.text_en: Please align the boxes along the back wall.
examples.text_zh: 请把盒子沿后墙排成一行。

examples.text_en: The two groups will align against the same problem.
examples.text_zh: 这两个团体将联合起来应对同一个问题。

examples.text_en: The wheels need a careful alignment.
examples.text_zh: 这些轮子需要仔细校正。

examples.text_en: Their alignment with the group grew stronger.
examples.text_zh: 他们与这个团体的结盟变得更牢固。

examples.text_en: The alimentary system helps the body use food.
examples.text_zh: 消化系统帮助身体利用食物。

examples.text_en: Good alimentary ways keep a person strong.
examples.text_zh: 良好的饮食方式使人保持强壮。

examples.text_en: This alkali is used in many daily products.
examples.text_zh: 这种碱被用于许多日常产品中。

examples.text_en: The water here has too much alkali for us.
examples.text_zh: 这里的水碱性太强，不适合我们。

examples.text_en: Her kind words helped allay the pain of the child.
examples.text_zh: 她亲切的话语帮助缓和了孩子的痛苦。

examples.text_en: We tried to allay the pain of the people.
examples.text_zh: 我们试图缓减人们的痛苦。

examples.text_en: The allegation was not supported by any evidence.
examples.text_zh: 这一指控没有任何证据支持。

examples.text_en: He did not believe the allegation from them.
examples.text_zh: 他不相信他们提出的指控。

examples.text_en: They allege that the money was taken last week.
examples.text_zh: 他们声称那笔钱是上周被拿走的。

examples.text_en: The report will allege a serious problem at work.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告将声称工作中存在一个严重的问题。

examples.text_en: The story is a clear allegory about human life.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事是一则关于人类生活的明确寓言。

examples.text_en: He made an allegory to show a simple truth.
examples.text_zh: 他编了一则寓言来说明一个简单的道理。
